purpose: Object-only recovery snapshot. No commit, ref, PR, main integration or Actions trigger is created.
incident: A capability refresh erased this author's and the independent receiver's functions memory before their prepared archives were durably saved.
recoveryMethod: Transcribed exact source from retained conversation tool/message text, then independently computed byte count, SHA-256 and Git blob hashes with native Node. Every value matched the pre-refresh source pins. No product test was rerun.

historicalObservations.baseline: 13 original maintained tests passed through an explicitly declared source loader before candidate implementation.
historicalObservations.authoredModel: 12 authored model groups passed on v1 and v2 through the declared source loader. The full maintained test source is now unavailable.
historicalObservations.independentModel: Peer reported seven groups, 60 compare plus 41 render calls passing on the exact v2 model.

limits: This snapshot does not contain either former complete archive and does not claim their raw outputs remain available.
No ordinary filesystem source/input receiving, full checkout, hosted gate, installed-client or main-integration acceptance is claimed.

The recovered original guide is preserved verbatim. Its maintained command names the now-unavailable model test; a disclosed successor guide is still required before treating that command as complete.

The six-file ordinary receiving closure totals 38,774 source bytes. Its seven groups require roughly 8.5 MiB temporary fixture capacity; prepared receiving requires at least 10 MiB free. No local staging or capacity probe was performed.
